howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: The plugin needs no configuration and works in the background.
howTo.item2: Orders from the Admin API, an ERP connection, a marketplace or an import get their primary payment and delivery filled in automatically.
howTo.item3: Without them the payment and shipping status stay empty in the order overview, and invoices show no payment or shipping method.
howTo.item4: On installation all existing orders are filled in once. Existing values are never overwritten, only missing ones are added.
howTo.item5: If the log says "Failed to fill primary order …", the console command act:primary-order-refs:fill adds the missing references.

info.description: Fills in missing primary payment and delivery references on orders created via API or import.
